name: Alex Moon
originStory: You were born to Mary Moon and Michael Moon, married eleven years by the time you arrived. She was out of work, he was a hairdresser. There was always food on the table and never quite enough for the rest. You were the second child. James came first and never let you forget it. Your grandmother Nina raised four children alone and had no patience for giving up. In Amsterdam, in 2026. Nobody there had any idea what you would become.

timeline.text: Born in Amsterdam to Mary Moon and Michael Moon — a getting by household.

productions.title: Paper Cousin
productions.premise: A daughter who stayed away too long comes back to a terrace due for clearance. A will leaves everything to one of them, and it is too late to be fair about it.
